notes.title: Pier Solar update patch released
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today we have released today an update patch that fixes numerous bugs and addresses some customer feedback as well as adding some BRAND NEW FEATURES:

Updates:
[olist]
[*]	Graphics have been updated to have a brighter tone, some paths have been visually de-cluttered. 
[*]	Healing spell: When used in game, it now shows the status of all characters while choosing who to heal.
[/olist]
New features:
[olist]
[*]	In game options:
[list]
[*]	Added SFX Volume control.
[*]	Added Encounter Rate control.
[/list]
[*]	In battle options:
[list]
[*]	Added Battle Animation speed control.
[/list]
[*]	Game modes:
[list]
[*]	When starting a new game, if the game has been finished once and the slot selected already contains a saved game, it prompts New Game or New Game+. 
[/list]
[/olist]
New command line parameter:
[olist]
[*]triplebuf = Uses triple buffering method for swap buffers. Helps to avoid tearing in some cases but may cause some imput lag in some computers.
[/olist]
About New Game+:
When starting a game with New Game+ the items and character levels from the slot selected are copied to the new game, thus making the player start with higher levels and plenty of items. 

We hope you all enjoy the updates, we're very happy to finally bring it live.

All the best!
-WM

notes.title: Pier Solar updated
notes.content:
Update notes 

2014-10-03

= Updates to graphic engine to address VSync for some graphics drivers

= Fixed dialog graphics for some special resolutions

= Updated Joystick support

= Fixed a bug that prevented the text for "Buy" and "Sell" from being displayed in Japanese

+ Restored Exit option on main menu

+ Exit keys (Ctrl+Q for mac and Linux, Alt+F4 for windows)

+ Reset to default controls (Press and hold F8 for 5 seconds on title screen while message Press A is displayed, a sound will confirm)
